editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text is never copied; Swoon'd writes its own explanation and links to the original. No FOM broadcast, radio or photo content is reproduced.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: Can follow a Grand Prix with a fan, decode common strategy, penalty and 2026 energy-and-aero chatter, and ask a follow-up that shows real understanding of why their team or driver's race unfolded the way it did.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No F1, Formula 1, FIA, Pirelli or team logos or liveries; team, driver and circuit names as plain text only; add a non-affiliation footer.
No press photos (Getty, LAT, Formula 1 Media, team). All flags, sidewalls, car parts and circuit outlines are original procedural art with licence id swoond-original.
No driver photos, caricatures or signatures at launch; numbers and initials only.
No broadcast clips, onboards or highlights (FOM rights).
No race audio or team-radio recordings; radio lines are paraphrased text. listening-id unused unless original audio is commissioned.
Publisher text is never copied; explain and link.

Jolpica-F1 dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and OpenF1 is non-commercial for free use: obtain commercial permission or use a commercial provider before production. No unofficial live-timing endpoints or scraping (FastF1, F1 livetiming).

safetyConstraints: Treat fatal accidents and serious injuries respectfully and non-interactively; no crash reconstruction or gore.
No gambling, betting odds or wagering content.
Keep start-light and flashing effects photosensitivity-safe and honour Reduce Motion.
Never present racing-line or driving sims as real driving instruction.
